name: refine-matk
author: BlaXun
description: Weapon refining also raises MATK, so magic classes get something out of a blacksmith too. Counts both hands for dual-wielders. Off until you turn it on.

settings.label: MATK per +1 refine
settings.description: Flat MATK per refine level on each equipped weapon. A +10 weapon at the default of 2 grants +20 MATK; a dual-wielder with two +10 daggers gets +40. Set to 0 to turn the bonus off without disabling the mod.
